userAdmin.orgManagerHint: May draw the organizational structure and appoint people to positions — typically an HR person. Independent of the role; only an administrator can still DELETE the structure.
userAdmin.orgManagerAutoHint: Nobody is an explicit structure manager, so the administrator covers it automatically. Use the switch to hand it to a specific person.
userAdmin.orgManagerAutoBanner: The administrator currently manages the org structure — until you appoint a specific person with the switch.

aiKredity.heading: AI credits
aiKredity.description: AI assistant usage for the organization and per person, in turns. 1 turn ≈ one ordinary message to the assistant (average of real usage; a long message with a photo or attachment costs more, a short question less). Counted from the assistant chat tokens; work of local models is free; the older AI features in the map are not counted yet.
aiKredity.settingsHint: The quota runs Monday 00:00 UTC to Sunday and does not carry over. Administrators may use the whole quota; their reserve cannot be used up by other members. 100 % = others get nothing, 0 % = no reserve. Quota 0 = no own limit (the operator's cap, if any, still applies).
aiKredity.split: Administrators: {{admin}} reserved, may use up to {{kvota}} · others at most {{ostatni}} credits
aiKredity.envNotice: The operator set a cap of {{kvota}} credits per week. Your own value can only lower it, not raise it.
aiKredity.vlastniNote: The assistant is currently running on your own model — chat turns do not count towards the quota (0 credits); photos and voice notes via our AI do.

aiVision.label: The assistant reads images (photos of notes, screenshots)
aiVision.hint: The model must see images (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1-mini, gemma4). After saving it is tried on a built-in image — images are enabled only when the model actually reads it.
aiVision.notTested: Not verified yet — save the settings or click Test an image.
aiVision.env: Image reading is set by the operator (KB_VISION_* environment variables) — it cannot be changed here.

customDomain.heading: Custom domain
customDomain.hint: killBottleneck and the agent chat can run on your own domain (e.g. tasks.company.com). The address {{slug}} keeps working.
customDomain.switching: Switching to {{domain}} — issuing a certificate and changing the instance address. This takes a few minutes; the app will be briefly unavailable.
customDomain.failed: Switching to {{domain}} failed: {{reason}}. Check the DNS records and try again.
customDomain.recordsIntro: At your domain provider (where {{domain}} is registered), add these DNS records:

check.dns_unavailable: DNS can't be checked right now, try again shortly

customDomain.tipCloudflare: If your DNS is at Cloudflare, set both records to “DNS only” (grey cloud) — we can't issue a certificate through the proxy.
customDomain.tipApex: A root domain (no www/subdomain) only allows an A record to the server IP. If we ever move the server we'll let you know and the record will need updating — a subdomain (e.g. tasks.company.com) is more reliable.
customDomain.tipWait: New records usually propagate within minutes, sometimes hours. You can repeat the check.
customDomain.tipLogin: After the switch you'll sign in once more on the new address. E-mails from the app will link to the new address.
customDomain.gatewayDown: The connection to the operator can't be verified right now — the status may be incomplete.

err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err.bad_domain: That doesn't look like a domain (e.g. tasks.company.com). killbottleneck.* addresses can't be used.
err.too_often: You can check once every 10 seconds (at most 30 times an hour). Try again shortly.
err.busy: The previous domain change is still in progress.
err.gateway_error: The request couldn't be passed to the operator. Try again shortly, or write to support@killbottleneck.com.
err.gateway_unavailable: This instance has no connection to the operator — we'll set the custom domain on request (support@killbottleneck.com).
err.unavailable: A custom domain isn't available on this plan.
err.admin_only: Only the organisation admin can set a custom domain.

kalendare.title: Shared calendars
kalendare.desc: Calendars that are not a person: company events, a meeting room or a car (bookings never overlap), vacations and time off. The whole team sees them; every member can add entries unless you limit it to admins. The assistant handles them ("book the meeting room tomorrow at 10", "who is away next week"). Never per user.
kalendare.empty: No shared calendars yet. Start with the presets.
kalendare.approvalOn: time off needs an admin or manager
kalendare.archive: Archive (events stay, the calendar leaves the menus)
kalendare.saveFailed: The calendar could not be saved.
kalendare.delete: Delete with its events (cannot be undone)

vlastniAi.heading: Own model or API key
vlastniAi.description: Instead of our AI, the assistant can think on your own model — on a PC with a graphics card at home or at work, or at a provider of your choice (OpenAI, OpenRouter and others). All it needs is a public address of an OpenAI-compatible API (usually ending in /v1), the model name and, if required, a key. Turns on your own model do not count towards the weekly quota.
vlastniAi.switchOn: The assistant uses your own model
vlastniAi.switchOff: The assistant uses our AI (own model off)
vlastniAi.tokenLabel: API key (optional — depends on your service)
vlastniAi.tokenSetNote: (saved ✓ — fill in only to change it)
vlastniAi.plainHttp: Unencrypted address (http://) — the key and your conversations will travel the internet in plain text. Use https:// (a tunnel gives it for free).
vlastniAi.advancedShow: Advanced: extra fields for the model
vlastniAi.extraLabel: Extra fields sent with every call (JSON) — e.g. turning thinking off in llama-server
vlastniAi.dataWhere: Where the data goes: the assistant's conversations, map extracts and the material for pages are sent to the address you enter — outside our EU processing, and you are responsible for that service. Photos for the assistant and voice transcription stay on our AI and use the quota.
vlastniAi.tunnelHelp: A PC at home: never open a port straight to the internet. Put a tunnel in front of the model (Cloudflare Tunnel, Tailscale Funnel) and enable a key on the model (llama-server --api-key). Local network addresses (192.168.…, 10.…) and Tailscale addresses (100.x) cannot be used from here — the server must not see them. The reply has to arrive within 100 s.
vlastniAi.noKey: This instance has no encryption key, so your API key cannot be stored safely. Contact support — until then our AI stays on.
vlastniAi.loadFailed: The own-model settings could not be loaded. Reload the page — Save is locked so the stored values are not overwritten with empty ones.
vlastniAi.tokenUnreadable: The stored API key cannot be read (the instance encryption key changed). The assistant will not use the own model until you enter the key again and save.
vlastniAi.testFailed: The test could not be started.
vlastniAi.notTested: Not verified yet — click Test connection.
